low.title: Half-Day Vukovar Nature Walk on a Low Budget
low.summary: A peaceful and refreshing short route through Vukovar’s natural riverside areas, parks, and green viewpoints — plus cheap, tasty local food.

schedule.title: Danube Riverside Warm-Up
schedule.description: A calm walk along the riverbank with relaxing views and plenty of shade.

schedule.title: Town Park Nature Stroll
schedule.description: Walk through green paths, benches, and quiet pockets of nature.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Affordable homemade-style Slavonian dishes — soups, stews, grilled meals.

schedule.title: Final Riverside Cool-Down
schedule.description: Sit by the water and enjoy the breeze before wrapping up.

medium.title: Balanced Half-Day Nature Experience
medium.summary: A comfortable mix of river views, peaceful parks, and a well-priced local lunch.

schedule.title: Riverside Walking Path
schedule.description: Start with the calmest stretch of the promenade, perfect for photos and relaxing.

schedule.title: Shaded Park Loop
schedule.description: A refreshing walk through one of Vukovar’s central green areas.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: A tasty traditional meal in a casual local restaurant.

schedule.title: Green Ending Walk
schedule.description: Wrap up with a short walk near the river or under tree-lined paths.

high.title: High-End Nature Highlights Tour
high.summary: A refined, scenic half-day route through Vukovar’s cleanest, most beautiful natural areas with a high-quality local lunch.

schedule.title: Premium Riverside Start
schedule.description: Walk the most scenic section of the Danube promenade for picture-perfect views.

schedule.title: Curated Park Path
schedule.description: Visit a well-maintained park with peaceful walking paths and greenery.

schedule.title: High-Quality Local Lunch
schedule.description: Refined traditional dishes made with excellent ingredients.

schedule.title: Elegant Nature Finish
schedule.description: End your walk at a quiet, scenic part of the riverbank.

comfortable.title: Luxury Vukovar Nature Retreat
comfortable.summary: A polished, peaceful half-day experience showcasing the best natural scenery and a premium local lunch.

schedule.title: Luxury Riverside Morning
schedule.description: Begin with the cleanest, most elegant riverside section.

schedule.title: Exclusive Nature Walk
schedule.description: Walk through beautifully landscaped green paths.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Local Lunch
schedule.description: Premium traditional dishes with refined flavors.

schedule.title: Premium Nature Wrap-Up
schedule.description: Relax at a peaceful nature spot with great views.
